# Orchid Documentation
Orchid is a generic, platform-agnostic multi-agent AI framework built on LangGraph (Python) and Next.js.
Audience: developers building or deploying multi-agent AI systems.
Each entry below is a documentation page with its URL and description.
Last generated: 2026-08-03

## Overview

Ecosystem Overview — Five packages, one coherent framework: library, API, CLI, MCP gateway, and frontend.
https://orchestratorindex.com/ecosystem

Quickstart — Run Orchid locally in under ten minutes with the basketball demo.
https://orchestratorindex.com/quickstart

## Concepts

Agents — How OrchidAgent works: YAML configuration, skills, MCP tools, and the run lifecycle.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/agents

Supervisor — The LangGraph supervisor: routing, history limits, and sliding-window summarisation.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/supervisor

Hierarchical RAG — OrchidRAGScope, the 5-level hierarchy, retrieval strategies, ingestion pipelines, and the parse-once pattern.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/rag

MCP Integration — Connecting MCP servers to Orchid agents: none, passthrough, and OAuth auth modes.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/mcp

OAuth & Dynamic Client Registration — How auth.mode: oauth triggers RFC 9728 → 8414 → 7591 discovery and manages per-user tokens.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/oauth

Embeddings — Supported embedding models, dimension differences, and re-indexing requirements.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/embeddings

Multi-LLM Support — Provider agnosticism via LiteLLM: configure any model per agent, swap at runtime.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/multi-llm

Chat Persistence — OrchidChatStorage ABC, built-in SQLite backend, PostgreSQL via plugin, and pluggable custom backends.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/persistence

Tool Call Strategies — The all, sequential, and llm_decides strategies and how to register custom ones.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/tool-strategies

Document Parsing — PDF and image parsing with the parse-once pattern and the pluggable parser registry.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/document-parsing

Mini-Agents — Per-agent opt-in fan-out: decompose a multi-part request into parallel sub-agents, each running its own focused agentic loop.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/mini-agents

Pollen + Bloom — Event-driven AI jobs: Pollen ingests and persists signals; Bloom matches them to triggers and runs them through the supervisor.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/pollen-bloom

Chat Summarization — Running summaries, structured entity extraction, RAG-augmented conversation memory, and configurable truncation strategies.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/chat-summarization

## Packages

orchid — The core Python library: ABCs, agents, graph builder, RAG, and persistence.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid

orchid-api — FastAPI server exposing the Orchid framework over HTTP with SSE streaming.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-api

orchid-cli — Command-line interface for interacting with Orchid without running the API.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-cli

orchid-mcp — Node.js MCP gateway that exposes Orchid to any MCP-capable host LLM.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-mcp

orchid-frontend — Next.js 15 multi-chat UI with SSE streaming and file upload support.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-frontend

orchid-storage-postgres — PostgreSQL storage plugin: chat persistence, checkpointer, and visibility fragment.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-storage-postgres

orchid-rag-qdrant — Qdrant vector and doc-store plugin for the Orchid AI framework.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-rag-qdrant

orchid-rag-chroma — ChromaDB vector-backend plugin for on-disk, zero-infrastructure RAG.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-rag-chroma

orchid-rag-neo4j — Neo4j graph-store plugin for knowledge-graph RAG.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-rag-neo4j

https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/basketball

Helpdesk Demo — Custom agent class, cross-agent skills, sequential routing, and event-driven ticket triage.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/helpdesk

Restaurant Demo — RAG with dynamic injection, multi-agent sequential routing, custom agent class, and event-driven deep research.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/restaurant

Recipes — Zero-infrastructure RAG cookbook example using ChromaDB and Ollama — no Docker, no external services.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/recipes

Education Studio — Four-agent teaching workflow with concept extraction, quiz generation, lesson planning, and multi-format export via PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and Markdown.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/education

Examples — Working examples showing different Orchid capabilities and integration patterns.

https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/learning

MCP Authentication Modes — All three MCP auth modes in one example: none, passthrough, and OAuth 2.0 with dynamic client registration.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/mcp-auth

Orchid Experts — Fleet of ten RAG-powered GenericAgent experts covering every Orchid concept — pure YAML + Markdown, zero custom agent code.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/orchid-experts

Postgres Storage — Demonstrates the orchid-storage-postgres plugin: asyncpg chat persistence, PostgreSQL checkpointer, and visibility.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/postgres-storage

Weather Fleet — Three-agent weather fleet: remote MCP server for live forecasts, built-in safety tools, RAG-backed outfit advice, PostgreSQL storage, and sliding-window chat summarization.

Custom Storage Backend — Plug in a custom OrchidChatStorage subclass via the storage.class field.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/custom-storage

RAG Retrieval Strategies — Side-by-side comparison of simple, multi_query, hyde, and a custom recency-weighted retrieval strategy.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/rag-strategies

Tool Call Strategies — all, sequential, llm_decides, and a custom priority strategy in one example.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/tool-strategies

Prompt Customization — Every supervisor and agent prompt extension point — assistant_name, routing/synthesis prompts, prompt_sections, and transformer prompts.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/prompt-customization

Gallery Curator — A multi-session art gallery curator that remembers artists, exhibitions, and decisions across sessions using Orchid's full conversation summarization pipeline.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/gallery-curator

Festival Producer — Multi-agent festival planning with artist booking, logistics, and marketing agents — backed by rag_augmented conversation memory, orchestrator skills, and structured entity extraction.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/festival-producer

Architecture Review Board — Multi-agent design review with structural engineering, cost estimation, and sustainability consulting — orchestrator skills and rag_augmented memory across design iterations.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/architecture-review

Graph Knowledge Base — GraphRAG retrieval strategy: graph traversal fused with dense vector search for multi-hop relationship queries.
https://orchestratorindex.com/examples/graph-kb

Wiki Document Ingestion — Two-tier corpus ingestion (headered + recursive), hybrid retrieval, and per-tool RAG overrides with the parse-once pattern.
